desc: NcSTAR's mission is to provide superior quality, scopes, rings, mounts, and firearm accessories to the shooting community at an affordable price. With over 12 years of experience they are dedicated to providing innovative and cutting edge optics and accessories with higher end features. By following the latest industry trends and setting the highest standards in the industry, NcSTAR has become the preferred choice of many professional, armed forces, and civilian consumers.
